edit.statement: A 1931 reference slip reading 'D or d', meant to add 'density' as a meaning of the abbreviation D, was misread and caused the ghost word 'dord' (defined as density) to appear in Webster's New International Dictionary, Second Edition (1934).
edit.subject: The misread 1931 'D or d' slip for density
